title: Graph Core
summary: This module defines the core components for building and executing directed graphs, including nodes, graph definitions, and graph run management.

nodes.label: BaseNode
nodes.title: BaseNode
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all nodes in a graph, defining the `run` method and node identification logic.

nodes.label: Graph
nodes.title: Graph Definition
nodes.description: Represents the definition of a graph, managing a collection of nodes and their connections. It provides methods for running, iterating, and visualizing the graph.

nodes.label: GraphRun
nodes.title: Graph Execution Instance
nodes.description: Manages a single execution of a graph, tracking state, dependencies, and the sequence of node executions. It allows for asynchronous iteration over nodes.

nodes.label: PathBuilder
nodes.title: Path Construction Utility
nodes.description: Provides a fluent interface for constructing complex execution paths within a graph using method chaining for transformations, mapping, and routing.

nodes.label: State Persistence
nodes.title: Graph State Persistence
nodes.description: Handles saving and loading the graph's state and node snapshots, allowing for durable and resumable graph executions. (Defined in 'persistence' module)

groups.label: Graph Definition
groups.title: Graph Definition and Structure
groups.description: Components responsible for defining the structure and behavior of a graph, including its nodes and overall configuration.

groups.label: Graph Execution
groups.title: Graph Execution and Runtime Management
groups.description: Components that handle the actual running of a graph, managing its state, dependencies, and the flow of execution.

groups.label: Path Construction
groups.title: Fluent Path Building
groups.description: Utility for programmatically constructing complex execution paths and workflows within a graph.
